title: Steven H NDE 4594
content: I remember opening my eyes and seeing a lot of smoke and the room was dark. I also saw two silhouettes looking at me. The silhouettes seen by me had no faces, nor limbs. They were about five to seven feet away and about forty-five degrees up. I only saw them from the chest up. Smoke surrounded around them. They were close together. At one point, they turned slightly towards each other. I felt no fear, no negative emotions after looking at them. I remember thinking, that I must let them know that I was alive. I blinked my eyes. No response from them. I tried to speak to them. I heard no words, but I could feel my mouth move. No response from them. I had a thought, I know I play guitar, so I'll wiggle my fingers. I wiggled my fingers on my left hand. As I did, I turned my head to look at my fingers. (I was lying on my back.) I looked down and saw myself (body) in the fetal position, lying on my left side. I was about five to six feet above my body. I did not panic, nor did I feel any fear. What I felt was 'the peace that surpasses all human understanding.' It is hard for me to describe. It was at this point the two silhouettes turned their heads (slightly) and turned towards me. I heard no audible words, but they told me 'Go to sleep. Everything will be alright.' They said this three times. As they did, I thought okay. I turned to my left side and curled up in the fetal position (This is the way I sleep best.) I closed my eyes. I felt myself drop down a little bit. I awoke in the hospital confused and scared. I would like to add that the two silhouettes I saw were not the emergency medical technicians. I talked to one of them later. He said he went in the apartment, threw me over his shoulder, and laid me in the snow outside than started CPR. This took about thirty seconds. While I had no concept of time with the silhouettes, I would estimate our conversation to be ten to fifteen minutes.

arrival.other_being_detail: Two silhouettes, faceless and limbless, seen from the chest up, surrounded by smoke, about five to seven feet away and about forty-five degrees up; they turned slightly toward each other and later toward him.

environment.environment_other_detail: A dark room with a lot of smoke; smoke surrounded the silhouettes.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: Experience began with seeing a dark smoky room and two silhouettes, then noticing he was above his body and later received repeated reassuring communication before returning to the body and awakening in the hospital.
stage_sequence.repeated_stage_detail: The message 'Go to sleep. Everything will be alright.' was repeated three times.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Two faceless, limbless silhouettes surrounded by smoke instructed him (without audible words) to 'Go to sleep. Everything will be alright.' three times; he then curled into a fetal position and felt himself drop down a little bit before awakening in the hospital.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “the peace that surpasses all human understanding.” / “Go to sleep. Everything will be alright.”
